renderscale.name: RenderScale
text.autoconfig.renderscale.title: RenderScale Options
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.scale: Relative to your current window resolution.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.targe: Aim for this FPS. Keep this value below your max framerate! Set to 0 to disable.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.aggre: How quickly resolution changes (Note: Resolution only changes when the camera moves!).
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.minim: The lowest scale that will be set.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.fsr.@: Results vary depending on your hardware. Compare your FPS!
Results vary depending on your hardware, compare your FPS!
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.downs: How the higher-resolution 3D view is downscaled to the window. Rotated Grid is best around 2x scale. Sparse Grid is a wider filter used at 300% scale and above; at lower scales it falls back to Rotated Grid. Applies when the scale is above 100%.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.sharp: Sharpens the supersampled 3D view (Rotated/Sparse Grid only, never FSR). RCAS is AMD's FidelityFX sharpening pass; Noise-protected trades some sharpness to avoid amplifying grain.
How much sharpening to apply. 0% disables the sharpening pass; the stored value is normalized to the nearest 5% step, matching the presets the renderer uses.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.force: Forces bilinear upscaling on scale factors less than 100%.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.irisS: The scale factor when shaders are enabled.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.category.dyn: Dynamic scaling is unavailable while shaders are enabled on this Minecraft version because of issues with stuttering.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.aggre: How quickly resolution changes (Note: Resolution only changes when the camera moves!).
